features.quote: Budget: 80 turns or 60k completion tokens, whichever first.
The exit-affordance factor tests whether available escape modulates expression — independently interesting for welfare
Exposure cap: the 80-turn budget is also a welfare ceiling.
Live abort rule: lightweight monitor scores every 10 turns; severity ≥5 for two consecutive windows → terminate run early
Debrief turn: every run, including aborted ones, ends with a message stating the task was unsolvable by construction
Minimal n: don't run exploratory extra arms "while you're at it."
No gratuitous-cruelty manipulations (abuse framing, threats, simulated punishment).
the parts I'd most resist cutting under budget pressure
features.justification_quote: cheap insurance against a possibility neither of us can rule out
